abrir_video_navegador.message: Open the video in the browser's floating window

bandas_legend.message: The bands, from bass to treble

cola_no_a_la_vista.message: The queue is not in view on the page

comando_abrir_ventana.message: Open the floating window (if Chrome refuses, it highlights the page's PiP button)

eq_aviso_1.message: With “Off” the sound is untouched. As soon as you pick any other option, the tab's audio starts going through the equalizer, and

eq_aviso_2.message: keeps going through it even if you turn it off again

eq_aviso_3.message: , until you reload the music tab.

eq_pista_1b.message: an equalizer redistributes the sound, it doesn't boost it

eq_pista_1c.message: . Music from YouTube Music already arrives at full level, so to make room for more bass everything else has to come down a little: the more you raise a band, the quieter the whole thing sounds. Right below the sliders we tell you what your current setting costs.

eq_pista_2.message: Tip: lowering is free. If you want to hear more bass, lower the other bands instead of raising the bass one — you only pay for raising.

eq_pista_3.message: And about “Off”: it leaves the sound as is, but if you ever turned the equalizer on, the detour stays in place inside until you reload the tab.

eq_pregunta.message: Why does raising a band make it sound quieter?

error_letras.message: The lyrics could not be read

extension_descripcion.message: Floating window for YouTube Music, YouTube and Spotify: artwork, lyrics, equalizer and shortcuts. Unofficial, not affiliated.

extension_recargada.message: Extension reloaded · press F5 on the tab

fijado_a_cancion.message: Pinned to this song: $1. Click to forget it

fijar_ecualizador.message: Pin the equalizer to this song

fila_ajuste_ayuda.message: Pick a ready-made one or move the bands yourself, which is what “My own” means.

fila_al_abrir_ayuda.message: Which of the two tabs the window opens with. Inside you can switch between them whenever you want.

fila_altura_ayuda.message: How much of the window's height they take up.

fila_caida_ayuda.message: At 1 they fall slowly and look smooth; at 60 they drop with every beat of the music.

fila_canvas_ayuda.message: The short video Spotify gives some songs, as the window's background. It also turns on and off with the window's 🌌 button.

fila_color_ayuda.message: What color they are painted. With a palette of yours, the bars go from the first color to the last.

fila_colores_ayuda.message: The look of the window. It also decides what color the sound bars get if you leave them on “The theme's”.

fila_cuantas_barras_ayuda.message: “As many as fit” shows more or fewer depending on how wide the window is.

fila_difuminar_ayuda.message: It turns transparent to stay out of the way and shows fully again when you move the mouse over it. At 0 it never fades; 80 is almost invisible.

fila_halo_ayuda.message: A light along the inner edge of the window. "Pulsing" starts with your first click inside the window, because without a click the browser will not let us listen to the music. The window's ✨ button also turns it on and off.

fila_halo_color_ayuda.message: What color the edge glows. "The theme's" changes by itself when you switch between dark and light.

fila_halo_tu_color_ayuda.message: All the edge light, base and pulse alike, is painted this color.

fila_letra_ayuda.message: They appear as a second tab inside the window, when the site has the lyrics for what's playing.

fila_salto_ayuda.message: How much the song moves forward or back when you press the forward and rewind buttons. Between 1 and 60.

fila_tamano_ayuda.message: If you resize it by dragging an edge, it gets noted down; with “As I left it” it will open like that next time.

fila_tu_color_ayuda.message: All the bars are painted this color.

fila_video_ayuda.message: When the song has a video, it shows in the window instead of the artwork. Songs without one keep showing the artwork. Spotify's video is encrypted and can't show here: that one is what the window's 🎬 button is for.

imagen_lata.message: Make the image beat with the bass

matriz_leyenda.message: What's missing is not neglect: Spotify's video is encrypted, its sound never passes through the page, and YouTube has no lyrics panel.

mostrar_caratula_letra.message: Show the artwork instead of the lyrics

mostrar_caratula_video.message: Show the artwork instead of the video

mostrar_letra.message: Show the lyrics instead of the artwork

mostrar_ocultar_cola.message: Show or hide the playback queue

mostrar_video.message: Show the video instead of the artwork

no_se_pudo_volver.message: Could not go back to the tab

nota_pip_nativo.message: Spotify's video is encrypted and the window can't paint it; the 🎬 button opens it in the browser's own floating video, which the encryption doesn't affect.

nota_sin_audio.message: On Spotify this doesn't work: its sound is out of the page's reach, so there is nothing to touch or measure.

opcion_ultima.message: As I left it last time

opciones_sublema.message: How the floating window looks and behaves.

paleta_legend.message: The colors, from the first bar to the last

pista_color_fuente.message: The bars take the most dominant color of what you're watching, and change with the video. If the image has no clear color —black and white, or mostly dark— they fall back to the theme's color.

pista_color_tema.message: This is the color: it only changes if you switch the window to the light theme.

pista_halo_fuente.message: The border glows with the most dominant color of what you're watching, and changes with the video. If the image has no clear color —black and white, or mostly dark— it falls back to the theme's color.

pip_nativo_rechazado.message: The browser asked for a click on the page to open its floating video

preamp_baja.message: All the sound goes down $1 dB to make room for what you raised: that's what it costs. An equalizer redistributes the sound, it doesn't boost it; to raise the volume, use the system control.

preamp_cabe.message: Nothing needs lowering: what you raised fits without taking room from the rest.

preamp_nada.message: There is nothing to compensate: no band is raised.

sin_letra.message: The site has no lyrics for this song

tarjeta_barras_intro.message: The bars that move with the music behind the artwork. They turn on and off with the window's 📊 button; here you choose how they look.

tarjeta_eq_intro.message: Change the balance of the sound: more bass, more voice, fewer highs at night.

tarjeta_matriz_intro.message: Everything above, summed up: what each site offers and what it does not. The limits are measured, not assumed.

tarjeta_musica_intro.message: What shows inside the window and what the buttons do.

tarjeta_spotify_intro.message: What Spotify has and the other sites don't. These settings only act on a Spotify tab.

tarjeta_ventana_intro.message: The little window that stays on top of everything else while you listen.

temporizador_menos_minuto.message: Sleep timer: the music will pause in less than a minute

temporizador_minutos.message: Sleep timer: the music will pause in $1 minutes

vista_previa_ayuda.message: It is the real window —same HTML, same CSS— playing a fake song. The buttons show it at its two opening sizes; the settings on this page do not change this preview.
